stage: Inference-only re-scoring of p1c's four retained checkpoints against a redesigned, stratified needle battery. Settles the window-ordering question that p1c's battery could not test.
relationship_to_p1c: SEPARATE CAMPAIGN. p1c's verdict is GATE_NOT_MET as pre-registered and is NOT amended, reinterpreted or superseded by anything here. p1d does not re-run p1c's gates; it asks a question p1c's instrument could not answer.
why_p1c_could_not_answer_it: p1c's battery has retrieval-distance support only at {110,311,512,714,915} and NO probes between 128 and 256, so f(128)=f(256)=0.1875 and the law predicts those two cells to be IDENTICAL. Its pre-registered 0.007692 gap was an artifact of measuring distance to the nearest occurrence of the answer token anywhere in context rather than to the planted needle; the entire gap came from one probe whose filler happened to contain the answer word. The comparison was untestable at any sample size, not under-powered. See the correction appended to p1c's PREREG-ADDENDUM.
no_retraining: Inference only. The four checkpoints are frozen; weights cannot respond to the battery.
instrument_fixes_vs_p1c: needle_pos recorded at generation; distance := ans_pos - needle_pos, never inferred by token search
probes whose answer or key token appears in filler are rejected and resampled (p1c: 7/128 contaminated)
three sequence lengths per stratum, breaking p1c's perfect depth/distance confound
negative control added, so p_chance is measured rather than assumed
guard band: no stratum within 16 tokens of any tested window
known_deviation: 2 of 32 strata (d=984, 1000) carry a single depth value: at ~1000 tokens of distance in a 1023-token sequence there is no room to vary length. Both lie outside every window except w1024.

preregistered_gates.G0_prerequisite: w1024 Battery-A accuracy >= 0.90, else INCONCLUSIVE (battery broken, not a refutation)
preregistered_gates.G1_positive_control: kv accuracy >= 0.80 in all four cells
preregistered_gates.G2_reproduction: re-scoring p1c's ORIGINAL frozen battery must reproduce its reported needle accuracy exactly (0.210938/0.203125/0.562500/1.000000). On failure the run is VOID -- this is the only defence against models.py reading its attention window from an import-time global.
preregistered_gates.G5_step_function: per cell: accuracy >= 0.90 on strata with d < W-16, and <= 0.05 on strata with d > W+16
preregistered_gates.G6_boundary: descriptive only, never gates: report the empirical step location per cell
preregistered_gates.pass_if: G0 and G1 and G2 and G3 and G4 and G5

limitations: ONE SEED (2100) per cell. This settles the ordering question FOR THIS MODEL and cannot upgrade a single-seed result into a law; model-level variance is unestimated at n=1.
One architecture (stablegla), one scale (110M), one training recipe.
The needle battery is held out in filler, placement and (K,V,position) combination, but not in content: the training needle pool draws from the same 65-word vocabulary.
